truth: each accepted target check before the write clears no-target-permission: target.getPermissions(cx),
cx.getUser().getPermissionsFor(target), ordTarget.canWrite(), the template's requireTargetWrite(...).
-- args --
@DIR@/m
-- want --
exit 0
-- stderr --
-- m/A.java --
class A extends BWebServlet {
  void a(WebOp op) { CsrfUtil.verifyCsrfToken(op.getRequest()); if (target.getPermissions(op).hasOperatorWrite()) target.set(p, v, op); }
  void b(WebOp op) {
    if (!op.getUser().getPermissionsFor(target).hasOperatorWrite()) return;
    target.set(p, v, op);
  }
  void c(WebOp op) {
    OrdTarget t = ord.resolve(base, op);
    if (!t.canWrite()) return;
    ((BComponent) t.get()).set(p, v, op);
  }
  void d(WebOp op) {
    if (!requireTargetWrite(target, p, op)) return;
    target.setDouble(2.0);
  }
}
